titulo: ⚽️ 10 Mind-Blowing Facts About the 2026 World Cup!
subtitulo: Discover crazy stats and hidden stories you never imagined about soccer's biggest event!

items.detalle: 3.2 million fans across all matches (world record)
items.descripcion: Stadiums saw unprecedented crowds, surpassing previous record by 15%

items.nombre: First Goal by an AI-Generated Player
items.detalle: 1st official goal scored by a robot-controlled player in a group stage match
items.descripcion: A hybrid human-robot entry netted the opener, sparking debate
Viewers worldwide could watch in native tongues, including newly recognized languages

items.detalle: 48 penalties taken over three matches, tying historic marathon
items.descripcion: Maratoníc shootout stretched across three separate games, breaking previous endurance record

items.detalle: 12 female officials managed matches, a first in World Cup history
items.descripcion: Entire refereeing teams were female, marking gender milestone

items.nombre: Most Goals in a Single Match
items.detalle: 12 goals in Germany vs Fiji (final score 12-1)
items.descripcion: Exploding offensive showcase broke the previous 11-goal max

items.detalle: 100% recycled ocean plastic in kits, reducing waste by 40%
items.descripcion: Teams wore eco-friendly gear, a sustainability leap

items.detalle: 1.5 million tonnes CO2 offset via reforestation, net-zero pledge
items.descripcion: Massive offset initiative made tournament carbon neutral

items.detalle: 5,000 VR headsets distributed to fans in Qatar, allowing remote attendance
items.descripcion: Viewers experienced matches live from home in immersive VR

items.detalle: 44-year-old Gianluigi Buffon scored a penalty, becoming oldest scorer
items.descripcion: Legendary keeper netted, defying age records

dato_extra: The tournament used 5 million trees’ worth of paper for tickets, then recycled every scrap.
